pieces.description: The set pieces on stage (all on stage before the first cue; the cues in steps.yaml take them out / in)

id.description: The piece's id (stable across renames; blocking/steps.yaml refers to it)

position.description: Centre of the piece's bottom [x, y, z] in stage coordinates (x to the audience's right, y up, z towards the audience); a curtain: the centre of its bottom edge (m)

rotation.description: Rotation around the vertical, counter-clockwise seen from above; missing = 0 (width along the stage's x) (°)

width.description: Width along the piece's own x: a table's length, a curtain's width when closed; missing = the shape's default (m)

depth.description: Depth along the piece's own z (not for a curtain); missing = the shape's default (m)

height.description: Height: a pyramid's apex, a table's top side, a curtain's cloth; missing = the shape's default (m)

legThickness.description: A table's legs: side of their square section; missing = 0.06 (m)

fullness.description: A curtain's fullness: the extra cloth in its pleats (0 = flat, 100 = twice the width of cloth); missing = the shape's default (%)

split.description: A curtain in two halves that open to the sides (missing = one cloth that doesn't open)

open.description: How far a split curtain is open before the first cue (0 = closed, 100 = open); missing = closed (%)

material.description: Material: how the colour reflects light (gauze = translucent, casts no shadow); missing = painted
